name: Blue Eyes, primite
extraDeck: Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres

combos.name: Ether Beryl + Sage — Full Endboard
combos.result: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon + Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon + Primite Drillbeam + follow-up

steps.title: Normal Summon Ether Beryl
steps.action: Normal Summon Primite Dragon Ether Beryl.
steps.why: Ether Beryl is the Primite starter and gives access to Lordly Lode.

steps.title: Set Primite Lordly Lode
steps.action: Activate Ether Beryl's on-summon effect and Set Primite Lordly Lode from the Deck.
steps.why: Lode is the bridge to Drillbeam and later provides Blue-Eyes follow-up.

steps.title: Add Primite Drillbeam
steps.action: Activate Lordly Lode and add Primite Drillbeam.
steps.why: This creates the Primite interaction you want available later.

steps.title: Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue
steps.action: Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue using Ether Beryl.
steps.why: Spirit converts your Level 4 starter into the Blue-Eyes engine and searches Mausoleum.

steps.title: Search Mausoleum of White
steps.action: Activate Spirit with Eyes of Blue and add Mausoleum of White.
steps.why: Mausoleum gives you the additional Normal Summon needed for Sage.

steps.title: Activate Mausoleum
steps.action: Activate Mausoleum of White.
steps.why: This enables the extra Normal Summon of a Level 1 LIGHT Tuner.

steps.title: Normal Summon Sage
steps.action: Normal Summon Sage with Eyes of Blue using Mausoleum's additional Normal Summon.
steps.why: Sage is the main Blue-Eyes tuner/searcher for this line.

steps.title: Search Maiden of White
steps.action: Activate Sage and add Maiden of White from the Deck.
steps.why: Maiden places True Light and later returns when Blue-Eyes is Special Summoned.

steps.title: Place True Light
steps.action: Send Maiden of White from your hand/field to the GY and place True Light from the Deck.
steps.why: True Light gives you another Blue-Eyes summon and a way to set a Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap.

steps.title: Send Blue-Eyes to the GY
steps.action: Use Mausoleum targeting Spirit with Eyes of Blue; send Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck to the GY.
steps.why: This loads the Normal Monster needed for the next summon and for Primite interactions.

steps.title: Summon Blue-Eyes
steps.action: Tribute Spirit with Eyes of Blue to Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the GY.
steps.why: Spirit's Tribute effect converts itself into the Blue-Eyes body you need for Synchro plays.

steps.title: Bring back Maiden
steps.action: When Blue-Eyes is Special Summoned, activate Maiden of White in the GY to Special Summon Maiden.
steps.why: Maiden becomes the second Level 1 tuner needed for the next Synchro line.

steps.title: Synchro Summon Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon
steps.action: Synchro Summon Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon using Blue-Eyes White Dragon + Sage with Eyes of Blue.
steps.why: Spirit Dragon gives you a strong endboard body and a GY-effect interaction.

steps.title: Set Wishes with True Light
steps.action: Activate True Light and Set Wishes for Eyes of Blue from the Deck.
steps.why: Wishes is a powerful 2-for-1 search and also has GY utility later.

steps.title: Activate Wishes
steps.action: Activate Wishes for Eyes of Blue, discard 1 card, and search the appropriate Level 1 LIGHT Tuner plus a Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap.
steps.why: Use the second search to prepare follow-up; the exact choice depends on what is already in your hand.

steps.title: Use Roar if appropriate
steps.action: If Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons is the search target and your line allows it, use Roar to Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon.
steps.why: Roar converts the searched resource into another Blue-Eyes body for the Extra Deck line.

steps.title: Equip Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate
steps.action: If the board state allows, banish Wishes from the GY to equip Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to Blue-Eyes as an Equip Spell.
steps.why: This provides targeting protection and uses Wishes' second effect.

steps.title: Make the second Spirit Dragon
steps.action: Synchro Summon another Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon using Blue-Eyes + Maiden of White.
steps.why: The second Spirit Dragon is the stepping stone into the higher Synchro bosses.

steps.title: Climb to Ultimate Spirit Dragon
steps.action: Tribute the Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon from the Extra Deck.
steps.why: Ultimate Spirit Dragon is the main field negate in this line.

steps.title: Crimson Dragon into Sifr
steps.action: Use your remaining Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon line to make Crimson Dragon, then target Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon with Crimson Dragon to Special Summon Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon.
steps.why: Sifr adds monster-effect interaction and destruction protection to the final board.

steps.title: Finish the board
steps.action: Use Lordly Lode to declare Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Special Summon it from the GY when appropriate; Set remaining interaction such as Primite Drillbeam.
steps.why: You finish with layered interaction plus follow-up rather than spending every resource.

combos.name: Ether Beryl — 1-card defensive line
combos.result: Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres + Primite Drillbeam + follow-up

steps.title: Normal Summon Ether Beryl
steps.action: Normal Summon Primite Dragon Ether Beryl.
steps.why: Start the Primite engine.

steps.title: Set Lordly Lode
steps.action: Use Ether Beryl to Set Primite Lordly Lode.
steps.why: Lode gives access to Drillbeam and can revive Blue-Eyes later.

steps.title: Add Drillbeam
steps.action: Activate Lordly Lode and add Primite Drillbeam.
steps.why: Prepare the Primite interaction.

steps.title: Link into Spirit
steps.action: Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue using Ether Beryl.
steps.why: Spirit gives you a route into Blue-Eyes resources and can search Mausoleum.

steps.title: Get Blue-Eyes on field
steps.action: Use Lordly Lode to declare Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Special Summon it when appropriate.
steps.why: You need a Normal Monster on the field for the Primite line and a second Dragon body.

steps.title: Make Hieratic Seal
steps.action: Link Summon Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres using two Dragon monsters.
steps.why: Hieratic gives you a bounce during the opponent's turn and a Dragon summon when it is Tributed.

steps.title: Hold interaction
steps.action: Keep Primite Drillbeam available and use Hieratic Seal during the opponent's turn when its bounce is valuable.
steps.why: This is the compact 1-card line when you cannot access the full Sage/Maiden sequence.
